strings.en: Sakura: Hmph, those Team Rocket{NEWLINE}goons were total pushovers.{CLEAR}Other than stalling with Substitute and{CLEAR}Protect, they couldn’t lay a scratch{CLEAR}on my Vaporeon.{SCROLL}And they thought they could stop us{NEWLINE}climbing the tower like that? Get real!

strings.zh: 玉绪『吔,此地乃缘朱市圣地,{NEWLINE}不可喧哗！

strings.zh: 小桃『小松馆主请勿戏言啊！

strings.zh: 小梅『吾等姐妹尚未起舞,{NEWLINE}凤王便已降临了？

strings.zh: 玉绪『小松馆主可看清了？{NEWLINE}当真是凤王吗？
strings.en: Tamao: Did you see clearly, Morty?{NEWLINE}Was it truly Ho-Oh?

strings.zh: 彩月『妹妹们勿言,{NEWLINE}且听小松馆主说来！
strings.en: Satsuki: Hush, sisters!{NEWLINE}Let Morty explain!

strings.zh: 小松『就在火箭队{NEWLINE}拖住你们的这段时间里,{CLEAR}有一个乔伊带领4个百变怪{CLEAR}变装成你们的样子,{CLEAR}来到塔上跳起了祈神之舞。{CLEAR}成功将凤王召唤了回来。{CLEAR}然后在几个火箭队员的掩护下,{CLEAR}一个黑皮肤的训练家突然出现{CLEAR}只用一球就抓住了凤王……{SCROLL}小松『虽然很遗憾,{NEWLINE}但现在凤王确实已经{CLEAR}落入了火箭队手中……
strings.en: Morty: While Team Rocket held you up,{NEWLINE}a Joy brought four Ditto up the{CLEAR}tower disguised as all of you,{CLEAR}and they performed the Prayer Dance.{CLEAR}They succeeded in summoning Ho-Oh.{SCROLL}Then, covered by a few Team Rocket{NEWLINE}grunts, a dark-skinned Trainer{CLEAR}suddenly appeared and caught Ho-Oh{CLEAR}with a single Ball...{SCROLL}Morty: I hate to say it, but Ho-Oh is{NEWLINE}now in Team Rocket’s hands...

strings.zh: 彩月『乔伊和百变怪！？

strings.zh: 小桃『这半年来那位乔伊多次光顾,{NEWLINE}竟是在为捕捉凤王做准备？！
strings.en: Momo: That Joy visited us many times{NEWLINE}this past half year. Was she preparing{CLEAR}to catch Ho-Oh all along?!

strings.zh: 小梅『可火箭队是如何得知,{NEWLINE}吾等所跳之舞{CLEAR}便是召唤凤王的祈神之舞呢？
strings.en: Koume: But how did Team Rocket learn{NEWLINE}that the dance we perform is the Prayer{CLEAR}Dance that summons Ho-Oh?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『火箭队曾经绑架了{NEWLINE}专门研究传说中精灵的秀力博士,{CLEAR}这些情报大概都是{CLEAR}从秀力博士那知道的吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Team Rocket{NEWLINE}once kidnapped Prof. Hale,{CLEAR}who studies legendary Pokémon.{CLEAR}They probably learned all this from him.

strings.zh: 彩月『原来如此……{SCROLL}彩月『冠军大人、小松馆主,{NEWLINE}凤王现已被捉,吾等该如何是好呢？
strings.en: Satsuki: I see...{SCROLL}Satsuki: Champion, Morty,{NEWLINE}now that Ho-Oh has been captured,{CLEAR}what should we do?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『火箭队捕捉凤王,{NEWLINE}肯定不是为了收藏。{CLEAR}他们一定会使用凤王出来作恶的。{CLEAR}我们现在要做的就是{CLEAR}做好与火箭队战斗的准备。

strings.zh: 小松『{VAR:0103:0}先生说的没错。{NEWLINE}为了救出凤王,{CLEAR}也为了保护这里的人们{CLEAR}不再受火箭队的侵害,{CLEAR}从现在起咱们就要做好准备,{CLEAR}到时候与火箭队决一死战！

strings.zh: 小松『{VAR:0103:0}小姐说的没错。{NEWLINE}为了救出凤王,{CLEAR}也为了保护这里的人们{CLEAR}不再受火箭队的侵害,{CLEAR}从现在起咱们就要做好准备,{CLEAR}到时候与火箭队决一死战！
strings.en: Morty: Miss {VAR:0103:0} is right.{NEWLINE}To rescue Ho-Oh, and to protect{CLEAR}the people here from Team Rocket,{CLEAR}we must start preparing now.{SCROLL}When the time comes, we’ll fight Team{NEWLINE}Rocket to the bitter end!

strings.zh: 玉绪『歌舞连乘几代人的舞蹈传承,{NEWLINE}就是为了这一刻的到来。

strings.zh: 小梅『近距离看到凤王了……{NEWLINE}好美啊……

strings.zh: 吔『嘿嘿,所有的训练家中,{NEWLINE}我只认可冠军大人你{CLEAR}有资格收服凤王。
strings.en: Sakura: Hee hee, out of all the Trainers{NEWLINE}out there, you’re the only one I think{CLEAR}deserves to catch Ho-Oh, Champion.

strings.zh: 凤王想与你较量一下,{NEWLINE}要跟它战斗吗？{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 小桃『顶冠如金、通体如火……{NEWLINE}何其美丽的颜色啊……！

We sisters shall take our leave now.
